name: Piercings And Tattoos
overview: The Scriptures instruct God's people to avoid bodily markings and alterations associated with pagan mourning rituals, as seen in Leviticus 19:28 and Deuteronomy 14:1, which prohibit cutting the flesh or making marks for the dead. While God adorns His people with jewels and earrings as a sign of His blessing and care (Ezekiel 16:12), the emphasis is on honoring God as His chosen servants (Isaiah 44:1, 5) rather than conforming to worldly customs. This teaches believers to find their identity and beauty in their relationship with the Lord rather than in external body modifications.
